title: The Secret in Their Eyes (bc30)
synopsis: For 25 years, a murder case has remained indelibly etched on Benjamín Esposito's mind. Now retired, he decides to go back over that story and take another look at a past full of love, death and friendship. Telling it is no longer just a pastime to fill empty hours, but a necessity if he is to give meaning to his remaining years, and finally face up to the woman he is still in love with. Winner of the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film, it stands alongside the later Wild Tales as a modern Argentine classic.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 檢察官 Benjamin Esposito 即使退休，也難忘一宗被勒令停止調查，未得公義的姦殺案。他以此懸案作小說題材，重新展開偵查，25 年的記憶隨之喚起：逍遙法外的強暴犯、人間蒸發的遺屬、嗜酒如命的拍擋和美麗動人的法庭書記……塵封多年的謎案、不求回報的真愛、沉澱的回憶一再湧起，未來又會怎樣改寫？ 南美洲上世紀末政治腐敗、法治黑暗，疊加上層層窒息感，那段球場追捕的長鏡頭更成為影史上最有張力的場景之一。勇奪奧斯卡最佳外語片，與幾年後的《無定向喪心病狂》並列為當代阿根廷經典。

cast: Ricardo Darín, Soledad Villamil, Pablo Rago
